figurative_meaning_en: The true state of the incident; deposition in court
example_sentences_in_bangla: আদালতে তার সুরত-হাল শুনে বিচারক অবাক হয়ে গেলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: It's necessary to inform the police of the surat-hal.
The judge was surprised upon hearing his surat-hal in court.
history: Derived from Persian 'surat-hal', meaning a written statement of facts, commonly used in colonial-era legal documents in Bengal.
note: Often used in formal and legal contexts in Bengali-speaking regions.
